text:
eli: Quick heads-up — running a dry-run for the dedicated capacity cutover this Friday. High-level timeline: 09:00 internal smoke, 13:00 limited traffic, 16:00 full route. Need fast acks on three items: 1) GPU crate ETAs (H100 units) 2) rack PDU/power survey status 3) reservation mapping for tenant quotas. Pinging infra/devex. @jordan @sam @maya

jordan: GPUs — vendor ETA shows pallets arriving Thu evening, but customs hold is a risk. Tracking WHSE-4521. If stuck, we can use the reserved spare set but throughput drops ~30%. Will follow up with a tracking screenshot in the morning.

sam: Rack PDUs — power survey for zone-b is complete. PDUs flashed, but rack-12c breaker reading is flapping intermittently. Opened INF-789 to track. I can swap the spare PDU from staging by 07:30 Fri if needed.

maya: Reservation mapping — I'm finishing the mapping for orgs A/B/C. Need the final tenant CSV from Product to validate quotas and limits. If we don't get that by Thu EOD I'll apply conservative caps to avoid overcommit.

ops-bot: deploy-checker: preflight for "dryrun/1758" finished — 6 warnings, 0 failures. Warnings: (1) node-label mismatch in rack-07, (2) missing monitoring hook on canary group. See https://confluence.internal/reports/dryrun-1758 for details.

rachel: Quick question on fallback: do we want traffic to divert to CPU-backed replicas if GPU nodes degrade? Need to confirm so I can update the runbook. :thinking_face:

eli: Yes — fallback policy is enabled (policy: fallback-capacity-v2) and will route to cpu-small replicas for latency-insensitive traffic. Jordan, can you confirm spare-set provisioning script is ready and drop a short test plan snippet here?

jordan: Will add script in PR #2345 later today. Test plan (short): smoke on 3 nodes, KV cache warm, run sample prompt load 100rps for 10m, assert p95 latency < 250ms and error rate < 0.5%. Command I'll use: `loadtest --host=canary.redwood-inference.internal --rps=100 --duration=10m --prompt-file=smoke.txt`

sam: Noted. If rack-12c still flaps after a reboot I'll swap the PDU in the 07:30 window. Who can grant me staging access to pull the spare? @rachel or @maya?

maya: Granted staging access to @sam. Also uploading the tenant CSV to /share/dedicated/tenants-final.csv (internal link). Please validate before Thu EOD.

rachel: Granting staging access now and adding a fallback-policy check to the runbook (section 4.2). I'll also add a small smoke script to validate routing after failover.

eli: Great. Last ask — owners: react with :white_check_mark: when you have the item covered, otherwise reply with any blockers.

jordan: :white_check_mark:

sam: :white_check_mark: (will confirm PDU swap done by 07:45 Fri)

maya: :white_check_mark:

rachel: :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: info: customs hold warning — typical delay window 48-72h. Monitoring tracking WHSE-4521 and will post updates.

eli: Thanks all. I'll compile these notes into the dry-run checklist and send the final window invite with the test plan attached. If anything changes, reply here so we have a single source of truth.
